title: Decoration Timer Overrun After Midnight
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holidaytimer:event
| search overrun_min>0
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(overrun_min) as overrun_min count as events by _time zone_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks decoration timer overruns over time and breaks it out by zone.
value: After-midnight overrun is the easiest way to spot holiday automation quietly wasting energy.
implementation: Send decoration timer overruns events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of decoration timer overruns by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how decoration timer overruns changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
